subject: POC MAP & evaluation kickoff — Avacare Health
body_preview: Quick kickoff for the Avacare POC MAP: confirm success criteria, owners for prompts/evals, and target close timeline.
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Tara Patel <tara@avacare.com>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@avacare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: POC MAP & evaluation kickoff — Avacare Health

Hi Tara / Evan —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our discussion, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) for the Avacare POC so we have clear success criteria, owners for prompts and evals, and a proposed close timeline. I attached a one‑page MAP template and a brief evaluation benchmark spec to this thread.

High level proposal (please confirm or edit):
- Timeline: 6 weeks from kickoff to decision (target decision week of 2026-07-13).
- Success criteria:
  - Quality: >= 85% pass rate on clinical triage prompts (per agreed prompt set).
  - Latency: 95th percentile <= 280ms for 512-token inference in production-like batch config.
  - Cost: under $1.10 per 1k tokens delivered after batching/quantization recommendations.
- Deliverables: weekly evaluation report, final benchmark summary, deployment runbook for Dedicated/Private paths.

Owners we propose from Redwood:
- Soojin Lee — program lead / single point of contact (MAP owner).
- Marcus Lin — infra & metric instrumentation owner (latency/cost dashboards).
- Marissa Cole — quality & evals lead (prompt sets, eval harness, regression checks).

Would you confirm Avacare stakeholders and owners for prompts/evaluations? Suggested Avacare owners: Tara (Executive sponsor / product), Evan (Engineering lead), Sarah Kim (data scientist — prompt author). If that looks right, we can lock owners and schedule a 30‑minute kickoff next week (I have Wed/Thu mornings PDT).

Next immediate asks:
1) Confirm success criteria above or propose edits.
2) Confirm Avacare owners and best contact emails (for invite).
3) Pick one 30‑minute slot for kickoff.

Attachments: Avacare_MAP_Template.xlsx (MAP template), evaluation-benchmark-specs.pdf (bench details).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scoped and started.

– Soojin Lee
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
(415) 555-0128

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Tara Patel <tara@avacare.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC MAP & evaluation kickoff — Avacare Health

Thanks Tara — and great to see owners aligned. Quick responses to the asks: 

1) Data retention / logging — Redwood defaults:
- Hosted API: request/response bodies are not retained by default; system metadata and telemetry retained for 30 days unless a longer retention is requested via the contract.
- Dedicated/Private: customer-controlled retention; we can configure 30 days for logs and disable storage of full payloads.

2) Evaluation benchmark plan (summary):
- Prompt set: ~250 clinician/triage prompts curated by Sarah (Avacare) + 50 adversarial prompts from Redwood.
- Eval harness: stable harness (pytest-based) with automated pass/fail and aggregate metrics. Marissa will own harness execution and result curation.
- Metrics: accuracy/intent-match, clinical safety flags, ROUGE for structured output where applicable; latency (p50/p95), and cost per 1k tokens.
- Target thresholds: accuracy >= 85% (as proposed), safety failure rate < 2%, p95 latency <= 280ms.
- Dataset: we recommend 2k anonymized historical cases for batch validation (shared via S3 link, Avacare to provide).

3) Owners & immediate actions:
- Avacare: Tara (exec sponsor), Evan (infra + data handoff), Sarah (prompts & labeling).
- Redwood: Soojin (MAP owner / program lead), Marcus (instrumentation/dashboards), Marissa (eval harness, regression checks).

4) Cadence & kickoff: weekly 30‑minute sync on Fridays for the duration of the POC; first kickoff Wed 2026-06-03 09:30 PDT (I will send calendar invites).

Next steps today: Soojin will update the MAP template with the Avacare owners and the small legal note on retention; Marissa will share a skeleton of the eval harness and the template prompt set.

Best —
Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
